I can't say whether this asset has lost tree cover since 2020. The analysis didn't run for ASSET-J. The land-change tool returned an error stating that the source coverage the asset needs has not been prepared, so no observation was made. The run metadata lists the intended parameters and datasets (Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change and JRC GFC2020, with a 2020-12-31 baseline and a 30% tree-cover threshold), but no results came back. The asset's area is also blank in the metadata.

This result shouldn't be read as "no loss detected." It means there is no evidence either way.

To get an answer, the coverage for this asset needs to be prepared and the run repeated. It would also help to confirm the asset's boundary or area. Until then, I'd treat tree-cover change for this asset as unassessed.
